# Nucleo UI glyphs for the zh 12 px cells (12x12): more-arrow (U+25BC), cursor (U+25B6), ellipsis (U+2026).
# Original work, drawn to match the Fusion Pixel zh 12 px glyph weight (the Fusion arrows are oversized). Positions
# are in cell coordinates: the dialog puts the cell of the more-arrow at (123 - cell_w, box bottom - 10).
